cleaner.label: Poetry (Python)
cleaner.description: Poetry cache and, as a separate option, the virtual environments it creates. Does not touch projects or configuration.

option.label: Poetry cache
option.description: Removes the repository metadata and downloaded packages (artifacts).

option.label: Poetry virtual environments
option.description: Removes all the virtual environments created by Poetry in the default folder.
option.warning: The projects that use them stop working until you run `poetry install` again in each one.
